affiliations.lab: Institute of Information Technology, University of Dhaka
affiliations.work: Developed NavA11y (published at ENASE 2026); constructed and released a 22-page labeled focus-behavior dataset; conducted manual evaluation with two expert raters (PABAK = 0.80). Now building RepairA11y — an LLM-driven repair pipeline for WCAG 2.4 violations testing runtime-evidence vs. static-evidence prompting (thesis, in progress).
Built a programming language-specific tokenizer to improve NLP model predictions for software engineering tasks.
